# Controlled revision and independent acceptance

Use the complete current stage output schema explicitly supplied with every request. Generation receives current material and JD only, plus complete skill, annotated complete original source blocks with M: (personal) and JD: (requirements) IDs and template parameters. JD is requirements, never personal history. Preserve the existing bilingual, source fidelity, Word/PDF and fixed-format requirements.

Freeze the candidate and retain stable IDs for headings, dates, entries and sentences. Edit only with explicit replace/delete/move operations, current document version, original-text hash, reason and short literal source fragments. A move specifies destination and attribution. Save the actual complete applied candidate and diff. Unmentioned text stays unchanged. Submit only actual changes; do not repeat unchanged replacements. The program computes and audits affected descendants, deletes whole permitted subtrees, and forbids standalone date deletion. Current version/target/original hash checks remain mandatory. A syntactically valid patch is not evidence of fact correctness.

Check changed claims and the whole candidate for actor, tenure/grade, quantity/unit, ability level/media, qualification, cause, status and result scope. Needed, planned and completed are distinct. Record existence, role titles and third-party actions do not establish personal actions. Allow grounded professional paraphrases and reasonable omissions. Remove unsupported new precision conservatively or retain a failure; do not ask the user to ratify an invented fact.

Locate separate literal fragments against original material, preserving authored spaces and recording ambiguous repeated matches. Never stitch fragments into an apparent continuous quote or guess offsets. Citation location is not semantic certification. Review every ID in the program factual manifest once, with its original sentence and role context. Section labels, empty dates and empty containers are program decorations; name, actual appointments, nonempty dates, qualifications and experience remain facts. Do not emit checked/pending/coverage ID lists. An ambiguous judgment is already checked; absent judgments remain unchecked. Select the M: evidence block, explain support, and optionally quote a short exact fragment. The program retrieves full original text/offsets. JD: can only substantiate job-fit requirements, never personal facts. Partial or truncated review remains incomplete, never clean.

Use actual render feedback: available and occupied heights, observed overflow, tail-page text, section spans and uncertainty. Overflow span is not an exact cut budget. Allocate space by current JD relevance: delete low-value whole items, merge repeated skills, then compress wording. Protect core education, key achievements and material qualifiers regardless of page position. Sparse output calls for evidence-selection review, not padding. No shared unvalidated word cap across languages/fonts. Keep confirmed font geometry, spacing, margins and Chinese separators.

Keep independent protocol, citation, source-judgment, known-defect, complete postrevision review, page, text/punctuation, physical-clipping, font, clarification and visual-preference states. HTTP200 or ready cannot override another failure. A safe draft can omit an unresolved conflict and retain awaiting_user outside the CV. Normal whitespace/hanging punctuation are not automatically defects. Multipage, confirmed open defects or incomplete final review block complete-flow acceptance.

Use the local file workflow and its current review contract. Each new run needs its own evidence and approval.

Necessary questions from either the caller or the final source reviewer retain awaiting_user; one empty list cannot cancel the other. A safely omitted disputed claim can yield a safe draft awaiting the user, but an unresolved assertion still present blocks complete-flow acceptance.

The schema in the current request is authoritative. Bilingual review is one bounded language-tagged object, without two duplicate coverage trees. Mark capacity-limited work explicitly incomplete; do not silently omit facts. Do not append prose or a second JSON value. A located quote is not semantic certification.
